inputs.factor: {"id": "F1", "name": "Technical Approach", "criteria": "The Government will evaluate the soundness and feasibility of the offeror's approach to migrating 140 mission applications to the Air Force cloud environment, including methodology, automation, cybersecurity and continuous ATO monitoring, and rationalization of legacy applications.", "subfactors": ["Cloud migration methodology", "Cybersecurity and continuous ATO", "Legacy application rationalization"]}
inputs.proposalPages: [{"page": 1, "text": "Northstar Digital Partners Inc Proposal in response to Solicitation FA8771-27-R-0012 \u2014 Enterprise IT Modernization Services Department of the Air Force Volume I \u2014 Technical 1. Assessment uses interviews with application owners and automated inventory scans. findings.text: The proposal addresses initial ATO support but does not describe continuous ATO monitoring after initial authorization.
findings.quote: Our team includes Certified Information Systems Security Professionals who have supported more than 40 Air Force authorization packages to an initial ATO decision.

expectedOutput.coverageNotes: Continuous ATO monitoring is not addressed.
